topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I never meant to snoop, truly, but the attic has this pull, a whispering kind of charm. Up there, the air hangs heavy with old stories, and I found these things—mementos, almost, of lives I know nothing about. A child’s shoe, tiny and worn, next to an old, leather-bound diary that smells of forgotten days. I opened it, just a peek, and there, in faded ink, are their thoughts, their dreams. I should close it, put everything back as I found it, but the weight of the pages is heavy, and I can’t help but wonder about the hands that last held them. I’ll return them soon, I promise. For now, I just need to understand.
